caveats: Adopting the starter changes each service's OpenAPI document once: Springwolf registers a schema-title converter in swagger's JVM-wide ModelConverters. crud: 22 title: lines; notification: 31. Nothing else changed.

springwolf.use-fqn=false is a starter default because Springwolf toggles swagger's JVM-wide TypeNameResolver during its scan; with true, a concurrent springdoc generation renamed every schema to its FQN. A service overriding it reintroduces the race.
springdoc.packages-to-exclude=io.github.springwolf is a lowest-precedence default; a service setting that property itself must add the package or InitialConfig reappears in its OpenAPI document.
gate.sh runs `api-docs.sh missing`, not the full `check` (D4 revision): drift is each service's own IT, run when the gate reaches a service.
publish has only been dry-run. No real upload: nexus.example.internal is a placeholder and there is no settings.xml server entry.

notification's AsyncAPI document describes the Kafka ingress although it is off by default in application.yml (it is the topic other teams publish to); the user-settings projection is excluded because its module is not packaged.
